extraction.Name: Arthur Parker
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged by Arthur Parker and wife September 19, 1918, to The Security State Bank, Winner, for $2500; on January 2, 1923, the land was again mortgaged to the State of South Dakota for $3500; on January 25, 1929, Arthur Parker deeded the land to his wife Martha for $1.00 and other valuable consideration, subject to the mortgage of $3500
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: taxes for 1928 amounting to $145.00 had not been paid at the time the records were viewed; the 1927 and prior taxes are paid
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612781 issued; Southeast quarter section 6, township 98, range 76; receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 13, 1918; mortgage to The Security State Bank of Winner was released January 8, 1923; mortgage to State of South Dakota had been extended from January 1, 1928 to January 1, 1933; wife's name is Martha; document dated JUN 1929
